stem.text: A power station using coal as fuel has an average power output of $3000\,\text{MW}$. Coal is supplied by 20 trains each day. The efficiency of the station in converting the thermal energy released from the coal to electrical energy is 26%.
A mass of $1.0\,\text{kg}$ of coal will release $33\,\text{MJ}$ of thermal energy when burnt.
Which mass of coal does each train bring?
